statusDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED: Source va runtime contract hien tai da dap ung quyet dinh.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL_IMPLEMENTED: Da co mot phan contract nhung con thieu output, UX hoac rule.
statusDefinitions.SAFE_FALLBACK_IMPLEMENTED: Da fail-safe, con cho nguon ERP/business de hoan tat.
statusDefinitions.PATCH_REQUIRED: Co the sua bang source hien co truoc pilot.
statusDefinitions.PATCH_REQUIRED_BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Can patch fail-safe, nhung rule day du con cho owner ben ngoai.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_EXTERNAL: Khong du evidence/schema/approval de implement dung.
statusDefinitions.DEFERRED: Da chap nhan nhung khong nam trong phase hien tai.
statusDefinitions.READY_FOR_PILOT: Quyet dinh ve rollout, san sang lap pilot gate.
statusDefinitions.SUPERSEDED: Quyet dinh cu da duoc thay the boi quyet dinh nghiep vu moi.
statusDefinitions.MEDTEST_RUNTIME_PASS: Source va runtime medtest da pass; con cho UAT bang mat hoac external sign-off neu co.
